answer: Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the kernel queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The sonnet index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1911 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the forge. A 89 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
